tags.name: design-builder
tags.description: Available design-builder over designs provided by Design Builder v2

get.description: Scan all designs linked to a organization, based in orgId attribute from JWT auth token

200.description: Success - designs loaded with success. Empty array if org has no designs.

post.description: Create a brand new design linked to a organization, based in orgId attribute from JWT auth token

get.description: Search for a especific design owned by user organization

delete.description: Search and delete for a especific design owned by user organization

409.description:
The design cannot be deleted: it is the only one of the organization, it is still
assigned to journeys (listed in `journeys`) or portals (listed in `portals`), or the
caller may not view the organization's portals, so their usage cannot be checked.

503.description: customer-portal-api could not be reached to check which portals use the design. Retry later.

put.description: Update a especific design owned by user organization. A body with `version: 1` is validated against the design document v1 schema and stored as v1. A v1 body leaves the stored `style`, `design_tokens`, `custom_theme` and `use_custom_theme` untouched. A body without `version` on a v1 design is treated as an old client's read-modify-write: those four fields are stored as sent, and brand-wide changes in `style` are applied to the v1 groups.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The `last_modified_at` of the design the client read. When it no longer matches the stored design, the update is rejected with 409. Without the header the update is unconditional.

409.description: The design was changed since the `If-Match` value was read. Returns the current design.

post.description: Duplicate an existing design owned by the user organization. The copy carries over the style, custom CSS and name (marked as a copy) but does NOT carry over journey/portal relations, so the new design starts with 0 consumers, exactly like a freshly created design.

get.description: Search for a especific design owned by user organization and parse them to a new or old theme. Deprecated: kept for old readers only. For a v1 design the response carries the v1 groups and the derived `journey` group next to the stored old fields and the theme built from them; new runtimes read the v1 groups.

post.description:
Generates a design (palette, text colours, font, logo and border radius) from a public
website with AI. The result is cached per organization and URL for 30 days.

200.description: A design generated earlier for this organization and URL

400.description: The URL is not a valid http(s) URL (`invalid_url`) or points to a private network (`blocked_url`)

403.description: The caller may not edit designs

422.description: The website could not be fetched (`fetch_failed`)

502.description: The design could not be generated (`generation_failed`)

504.description: The generation did not finish in time

post.description:
Reads a public website and returns a v1 design document plus one finding for each
id in fixed order. This version chooses the favicon in code and derives the site name.
The other findings are `not_found` until they are implemented. The document contains
only the leaves that passed validation, and defaults are not pruned.
Successful responses are cached per organization, normalised URL and generator version
for 7 days. Each organization may run 20 new generations per UTC day; cache hits do not
count toward the limit. A client abort still finishes on the server and is cached.

200.description: A design document generated earlier for this organization, URL and generator version

400.description: The URL is not a valid http(s) URL (`invalid_url`) or points to a private network (`blocked_url`)

403.description: The caller does not have design:create

422.description: The website could not be fetched (`fetch_failed`)

429.description: The organization has used today's generation limit (`rate_limited`)

502.description: Generation failed, or no finding survived (`generation_failed`)

_manifest.description: The manifest IDs associated with this design

Design_Document_V1.description: Groups of the design document v1. A design is v1 when `version` is 1, otherwise it is the old shape (`style`, `design_tokens`, `custom_theme`). The authoritative contract for the groups is the schema exported by @epilot/design-document. A v1 design keeps `style`, `design_tokens`, `custom_theme` and `use_custom_theme` as stored. The `journey` group is not accepted yet.

topbar_logo_alignment.description: Logo/content alignment in the top bar

input_border_radius.description: Input field border radius in pixels

button_primary_bg.description: Primary button background color or gradient

button_primary_hover_bg.description: Primary button hover background color or gradient

card_border_color.description: Card border color for outlined variant

datepicker_selected_bg.description: Date picker selected date background color

datepicker_selected_color.description: Date picker selected date text color

datepicker_border_radius.description: Date picker border radius in pixels

url.description: Public website to derive the design from

cached.description: True when the design was generated earlier for this organization and URL

url.description: Public website to read the design from

family.description: Font family that was found but cannot be loaded

cached.description: True when the response was served from an earlier successful generation for this organization, normalised URL and generator version

GeneratedDesign.description: Partial design to merge into the design being edited

file_id.description: ID of the source file entity in the epilot file-entity system. Set when the file was picked from the File Manager (rather than uploaded directly to the design-builder bucket). Consumers resolve the live `public_url` via this reference. The org id is derived from the journey's owning org at render time (same convention as journey image blocks), so blueprint cross-org installs work without any extra remapping.

Theme.description: Type of theme to be parsed and returned

Application.description: Type of application that uses the design

journey_design_tokens.description: Design tokens for journey customization (renamed from design_tokens)

journey.description: v1 designs only: the journey group of @epilot/design-document (custom_css, tokens and the journey overrides primary_color, font, border_radius, logo), derived on read from the stored journey fields and compared with the stored v1 groups. What a journey paints from it equals what it paints from the theme built from the old fields. Not returned by GET.
